reason: The studio's category union and write-allowlist had no way to express or display the friction kind, so a valid artifact was unrepresentable and rejected.
An existing coverage command parses .tsx sources under the wrong ScriptKind default, silently understating contract coverage.
The repo-wide substitution used an unresolved/overloaded placeholder convention and wrote edits into files outside the session's scope.
The build command incorrectly writes to the launching session's presence row, adopting and then terminating a declaration it should not own.
Spawned builders ended their turn waiting for a notification that never comes, stopping before the lane's objective was achieved.
A launch path that exists boots successfully but 500s every API route and emits an error naming a workspace package rather than the missing loader.
No mechanism exists to scaffold a new package within the build's per-phase write fences, so no leaf can ever reach a genuine red.
The .strict() wire schema cannot express an additive producer field, so the usage stream silently stopped persisting.
A correct-when-written negative existence premise in a brief expired due to concurrent sibling work, which none of the 18 modes describes.
The coverage check ran but validated against a test title rather than the contract's clauses, so it read 7/7 while clauses stood unasserted.
The gate orders its cheap claim check after typecheck and the full test suite, so a ten-second fix costs a full re-run.
The mirror-conformance check covers only one of several re-composed routes, so it verified part of the surface and missed the drifted claims mirror.
No claim or mutex exists over the friction queue, so concurrent adjudicator seats can drain and overwrite the same items unrefused.
The check's V=0 ceiling is scoped per-repo rather than per-author, so it attributes a sibling's live drift to the session running the gate.
The command fails to resolve the house @path convention and performs a wholesale destructive record write, destroying the prior verdict.
The machine-scoped hook registration binds to whatever branch a host checkout sits on, so the platform state rather than repo code decides what is enforced.
The documented one-shot incantation assumes the script sits inside the workspace and fails twice with errors naming neither cause.
The sheet and delivered PNG dir carry no per-cell record of the code state, so a two-variable comparison is indistinguishable from a one-variable one.
The rollup renderer's fixed ordering puts the actionable parked section last, so truncation silently removes it while the render looks complete.
The build's AUTHOR_TEST turn budget exhausted twice on an isolatable two-file unit, promoting no patch.
The probe ran but its stable-picture predicate measured only accretion, admitting visually changing frames into the comparison.
The authoring session omitted a check of a steering comparative against two artifacts already in the store, and neither authoring nor consumption verified it.
The lifecycle rule reads only the increment log, so chip-carried work cannot be seen by the surface that decides closure.
The check reports a routine 'stale' signature while already holding the fact that the documented remedy cannot work, making the printed remedy actively wrong.
No edge, tag, or gate rung exists that can detect a cross-ADR semantic falsification of a prescribed build address.
The shell pipeline holds stdout open so the harness timeout SIGTERMs the detached gate — a platform/shell interaction, not repo code.
The fence ran but asked about the branch diff rather than the promise, so it reported a broken promise falsely and its sibling would pass while untrue.
No kind-agnostic text search verb exists over the corpus, so the absence claim cannot be proved at any reasonable cost.
The non-vacuity guard ran but counted a quantity no prop change can move, so it passes over a picture missing the subject.
A Linux-CI rmdir race in temp-fixture teardown reds the job on branches that touch none of the code.
The harness hardcodes a steady-state navigation budget with no override, so the first cold-vite capture refuses with a message naming the page.
Bun is installed but absent from the dev box's PATH, so the machine — not the repository's code — turns the gate red.
The live signing path omits the memoization its sibling command has, re-running an identical deterministic command once per leg.
An existing probe observes only one credential source and prints a fix hint prescribing a retired and actively dangerous invariant.
The rerun comparison emits a confident FLAKE verdict for store-reading rungs it cannot see into, asserting nothing was fixed when something was.
The measurement ran and reported green on a mis-parameterised call, so the check passed while the published figures were wrong.
The rung's closing message offers only two remedies and omits the correct third, steering sessions toward tests that cannot work or a dead-code disable.
The committed reproduce command defaults to an asset URL that no committed file satisfies, failing with a 404 naming neither the missing nor the available asset.
A skip-capable gate rung fails to take its skip branch on a fresh worktree, reddening the gate regardless of branch content.
A flag interaction re-arms a fence the documented --discharged-by exemption should clear, and the refusal prescribes minting a second increment for landed work.
